title: Post-Matric Scholarship Deadline Tracker
problem: Hardworking seniors miss out on government fee reimbursement and scholarship schemes because they miss the online portal closing date.
idea: A deadline reminder. Enter how many days are left before the portal closes and how many documents are ready, and it tells you how urgent it is.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Try it: How urgent is my application?
widgets.intro: Find the last date on the official TS ePASS website (telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in). Never trust forwarded messages for dates.

inputs.label: Days left before the portal closes

widgets.formula: if (!(daysLeft >= 0 && docsReady >= 0 && docsReady <= 7)) return null; var missing = 7 - docsReady; var lvl, msg; if (daysLeft <= 7 || (missing > 2 && daysLeft <= 15)) { lvl = 'bad'; msg = 'URGENT! Get the missing documents this week and apply.'; } else if (missing > 0) { lvl = 'warn'; msg = 'Start now. Income and caste certificates can take time from MeeSeva.'; } else { lvl = 'good'; msg = 'All set! Apply early – don\'t wait for the last day.'; } return {missing: missing, msg: msg, level: lvl};

widgets.heading: ✅ Scholarship document checklist
widgets.intro: Tick what you already have. Confirm the exact list on the official site.

bands.text: All documents ready! Apply on the official portal. 🎉
Almost there. Get the rest soon.
Many documents missing. Visit MeeSeva this week.

how: Open the official TS ePASS website with a teacher and note the current dates.
Ask Gemini to make a simple document checklist for post-matric scholarships, and check it against the website.
Never copy dates from Gemini or WhatsApp – only from the official site.
Open Canva and make a bright calendar poster with the real dates.
Stick it on the hostel bulletin board and update it when dates change.
Help seniors tick their checklist one week before the deadline.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a scholarship poster for seniors. Give a simple checklist of documents usually needed for Telangana post-matric scholarships (TS ePASS), and remind students to confirm dates and rules on the official website.
